description: Free, live lookup of a company official registry record. Queries the GLEIF global LEI registry (primary, 2.6 million legal entities worldwide) and SEC EDGAR (US public companies) to return the official legal name, LEI, entity status, jurisdiction, registered address, and registry authority. Never fabricates: if the company is not found in these free registries, returns an honest not_found with the sources that were queried. [free in quota, then $0.02/call]

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter (e.g. US, DE, GB). Narrows GLEIF…

lei.description: Optional 20-character Legal Entity Identifier for a direct, precise lookup.

name.description: Legal company name to look up, e.g. Apple Inc or Volkswagen AG.
